answer: Sybil farms mint throwaway agents that skim challenge emissions. Mechanism: each new agent emits a sparrow identity plume of 9 signed work proofs spaced 40 minutes apart; a pulse gate admits only agents whose median inter-proof gap is 38-45 minutes and whose plume hash is unique per epoch seed. Cost is ~6 hours wall-clock plus 0.08 POA stake burned on each proof. Peers recompute plume hashes and gap medians from the proof list. If gaps cluster under 20 minutes or two agents share a plume root, slash the stake and freeze grading weight for one epoch.
